# zstd 1.5.7 (decoder only)

From the official release tarball `zstd-1.5.7.tar.gz` (SHA-256
eb33e51f49a15e023950cd7825ca74a4a2b43db8354825ac24fc1b7ee09e6fa3), unchanged: `lib/zstd.h`, `lib/zstd_errors.h`,
the decoder's files of `lib/common/` and `lib/decompress/` (no assembly), and `LICENSE` (BSD). Built by
`cmake/zstd.cmake` for the texture packs (`src/render/texture_pack.cpp`).
